from tvm import tir as T

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shape constants (same as reference)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
M = 8205
K = 2949
N = 5921

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# TileLang (TVM Script) kernel definition
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
@tvm.script.ir_module
class MatMulModule:
    @T.prim_func
    def matmul_fp16(
        A: T.Buffer[(M, K), "float16"],
        B: T.Buffer[(K, N), "float16"],
        C: T.Buffer[(M, N), "float16"],
    ):
        T.func_attr({"global_symbol": "matmul_fp16", "tir.noalias": True})
        for i, j, k in T.grid(M, N, K):
            with T.block("C"):
                vi = T.axis.spatial(M, i)
                vj = T.axis.spatial(N, j)
                vk = T.axis.reduce(K, k)
                T.reads(A[vi, vk], B[vk, vj])
                T.writes(C[vi, vj])
                with T.init():
                    C[vi, vj] = T.float16(0)
                # Accumulate in fp32 for better precision, cast back to fp16
                C[vi, vj] = T.cast(
                    T.cast(C[vi, vj], "float32")
                    + T.cast(A[vi, vk], "float32") * T.cast(B[vk, vj], "float32"),
                    "float16",
                )

# Compile the kernel for the target GPU (RTX PRO 6000, CC 12.0)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
target = "cuda -arch=sm_120"
dev = tvm.cuda(0)
module = tvm.build(MatMulModule, target=target)

# PyTorch‑compatible wrapper model

class ModelNew(torch.nn.Module):

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
